case.title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement. Need: 20000 pc a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 7 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200004. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

You pointed to labour and material costs behind your quote, and the multi-year volume you are looking for is what our options are built around: each of them runs for a longer contract term, which gives your capacity a steadier base.

Option A is the package we can approve. It combines a longer commitment with a unit price and payment term that work for both family companies, and it sits on a quality record you can see for yourself:

On quality:
Your quality was 302 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70620@2026Q3).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.52; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.57; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.54; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. As you do not decide this alone, could you please take Option A to the person who does? What it offers your company is a longer contract term for this bearing and a partner who stays with you.

To help us understand your calculation:
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. Please note that as a matter of company policy, we do not disclose internal cost breakdowns. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. We have reviewed your proposed options and your request for a longer contract term.

Our offer is a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

As an alternative, we can accommodate the 24-month term and 45-day payment target at a unit price of €4.90, which represents our definitive position for this package: a price of €4.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

Our offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for confirming that the quality record holds. We will not argue costs further, since you prefer to keep your calculation to yourselves. Instead, we put forward terms that give you the steady volume base your business needs.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.57; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.59; payment 60 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.62; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Our current offer stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

You mention a steady volume base; please provide the specific volume figures you anticipate. Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. 

In response to your question regarding Option A, we can confirm a 24-month term and 45-day payment at a unit price of €4.89. Specifically, we can present this alternative at a price of €4.89 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

You asked which volume we can commit to, and our new options answer that directly: every option carries a binding annual volume over the full contract term, which gives your free capacity a firm and predictable base.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.61; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.66; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.63; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Binding volume in every option: 20,000 units a year over 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

We are asking for a fair solution for both family companies, built to last.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. We acknowledge your proposal of a binding volume of 20,000 units per year over the 24-month contract term. While we appreciate this commitment, it does not alter our calculation sufficiently to reduce the price further. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our offer stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Please note that this offer is valid for 7 days.

Looking ahead, a binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? We are always keen to support your supply needs from our extensive range with our best possible service.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
